subbundles: SB01
Current-state and proof integrity audit
Establish exact post-v7 baseline and reject empty or stale proof artifacts.
Inventory changed files in both repos since previous bundle.; Run focused builds/tests/audits or capture why impossible.
SB02
Pause/stop ordering and idle browser proof
Fix the observed Pause bug by stopping browser runtime immediately, then draining C# playback task.

Change `RunPlayback.StopPlaybackAsync` ordering: request cancellation, immediately call `StopRuntimeActivityAsync(waitForIdle:true)`, then wait for playback task drain.; Ensure late callbacks cannot change UI after stop generation changes.
SB03
Runtime idle hard-fail semantics
Make idle timeout a hard failure in all proof/claim paths.
Add explicit hard-fail option to `applyCommandBatchAndWait` or C# wrappers.; Ensure `runtimeIdle=false` cannot appear in a successful proof result.
SB04
Browser observer artifact-backed proof
Convert browser observer proof from smoke/demo to artifact-backed evidence.

Create an observer proof artifact schema with route, viewport, WebGlRunDocument hash, browser-loaded hash, runtime diagnostics, console errors, idle result, and screenshot path.; Add Components proof route that can load a generated WebGlRunDocument artifact, not only a hard-coded demo document.
SB05
Readiness report evidence contract
Prevent research-ready status from boolean-only flags.

Replace/extend `BrowserRuntimeExercised`, `UIExercised`, and `OracleProofExercised` with evidence records or artifact citations.; ResearchReady must require valid evidence artifacts with hashes and schemas.
SB06
Unclassified diagnostics closure
Ensure every diagnostic contributes to a band or explicit unclassified failure.

Add diagnostic classifier that classifies input, backend, projection, metrics, oracle, performance, runtime, and UI messages.; Any unknown backend/input diagnostic becomes `unclassified-diagnostic` error in research mode.
SB07
Design matrix factor materialization
Ensure experiment factors actually mutate scenario input/configuration or are rejected.

Implement factor bindings: parameters, policy fields, scenario metadata, resource quantities, event magnitudes, behavior profile, seed, or run-plan options.; If a factor has no binding, fail with `design-factor-no-effect`.
SB08
External golden oracle corpus
Move oracle expected values from code-only helpers to data fixtures.

Create `tests/Fixtures/GoldenOracles/*.json` or equivalent scenario-pack oracle folder.; Oracle fixture stores expected stores, flows, issues, relationships, metrics, invariant results, frame hash chain, and tolerated diagnostics.
SB09
Metamorphic and conservation property tests
Add broad noise-detection tests beyond fixed golden cases.
Add conservation tests: resource total conserved except explicit source/sink/rejection rules.; Add order tests: reordering independent events should not change final hash.
SB10
Store resolution policy completeness
Eliminate implicit store-selection noise in research mode.
Require explicit store-resolution policy when candidate count > 1 for source, target, shared, and effect roles.; Emit structured metadata for accepted and rejected flows for every role.
SB11
Metric/invariant evaluator no-fallback mode
Ensure strict evaluator calls cannot silently return zero/fallback values.

Add strict evaluator options or context to `SimulationFrameMetricEvaluator` and `SimulationInvariantEvaluator`.; Unknown metric kind and unknown invariant kind must error at evaluation time, not only definition validation time.
SB12
Behavior profile lockfile and diff tooling
Make event expansion drift explicit and comparable.
Emit behavior profile lockfile in headless manifest and scenario pack validation.; Add diff tool section for behavior profile id/version/hash/ruleset/rule fingerprints.
SB13
Headless runner manifest v3
Harden reproducibility manifests and artifact validation.

Add manifest schema v3 if needed with repository commits, package versions, policy, scenario/source hashes, design matrix hash, oracle corpus id, metric registry version, invariant registry version.; Manifest diff must categorize environment-only vs model-affecting changes.
SB14
Statistical comparison and non-comparability gates
Make multi-run experiment comparisons safe.
Design harness must require explicit design matrix for comparisons unless single-run exploratory is declared.; Stochastic mode must require seeds/repetitions and report variance/sample count.
SB15
Browser performance observer budget
Keep browser performance separate from economic truth but useful for visual exploration.
Add browser observer performance proof: load, first frame, settled frame, pause idle, batch settle.; Browser budget failures block `browser-observer-valid` but not headless validity.
SB16
Final cross-repo red-team closure
Perform final adversarial review and produce next-step decision.
Run focused tests/builds in both repos.; Run proof validator and fail on empty artifacts.
